about: Octave evidence a person set, kept apart from the generated data/octave-evidence.json so a rebuild cannot drop it. src/lib/songs/octaveFiles.ts merges the two when the evidence is loaded (scripts/octave-fix.ts does). An artist listed here takes the place of the measured typical note in the artist rule (same limit, ARTIST_MAX_DISTANCE), which also keeps the pitch rule off that artist, and the moves that rest on it are marked octaveFrom: 'hand'. A song under keep is never moved. To add an artist: the artist part of the song key, a typical note as a MIDI number (A#4 is 70) and where it came from; run scripts/octave-fix.ts with --dry-run first. A song under keep that the fix had already moved before it was listed is put back as written by scripts/octave-restore.ts, from the copy of song_ranges taken before the fix ran (dry run first); listing it here is also what stops a rerun of the fix moving it again. A source has to say whether it gives sung pitch: Singing Carrots does (its ranges for male leads sit an octave below Musicnotes'), while Musicnotes lists a male lead at written pitch, an octave above where he sings and a female lead at the pitch she sings.

ac/dc.source: Quinn-Wai, by ear, 11 Nov 2026 (QWW-42): You Shook Me All Night Long is about G4 to C5 and Hells Bells is near C5. A#4 is the middle of You Shook Me.
